name: How do I compare whole-home renovation contractors in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How should I compare contractors for a whole-home renovation in Los Angeles when the bids look very different?
mainEntity.text: How should I compare contractors for a whole-home renovation in Los Angeles when the bids look very different?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fair comparison starts with scope. If one contractor includes design coordination, permits, demo protection, and realistic finish allowances while another leaves those out, the lower bid may not be the better value. Look for experience with projects similar in size and complexity to yours, especially if your home is older or needs structural changes. Ask how they handle change orders, inspections, and schedule updates. Also review whether they provide a dedicated project manager, regular site communication, and clear allowances for cabinets, tile, fixtures, and appliances. The strongest proposal is the one that gives you the clearest picture of what the project will actually cost and how it will be delivered.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare contractors by scope clarity, experience with full-home projects, permit handling, communication, schedule realism, allowance quality, and exclusions. The cheapest bid is often the least complete. Ask for a line-by-line proposal that makes it easy to compare labor, materials, and finish assumptions.
